title: 90% Indian employers expanding tech workforce for AI opportunities
description:
As many as 90 per cent of Indian employers are increasing their technology workforce to scale services and generate new revenue through artificial intelligence (AI), the second-highest proportion globally after the US, according to a report.
The findings of talent company Randstad's global report, Tech Talent in Transition: Building the AI-Ready Workforce, are based on primary research conducted in the first half of August 2026 across 11 markets -- Australia, Belgium, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands, Spain, the UK, and the US.
"90 per cent of Indian employers are increasing tech headcount to scale services and generate new revenue through AI. This is second only to the United States (93 per cent) and above the global average of 86 per cent," the report said.
